rule: Reuse original decoder, 32-tick V1a common-G branches and raw BF. Candidate output blending never feeds back into either branch.

score_definition.fusion_segment: Trusted conditional mean to unchanged V1a common-G output
score_definition.residual_score: Squared projection of current trusted innovation times G on segment direction
score_definition.posterior_mean_score: Squared projection of the conditional mean prefix state displacement on the segment direction
score_definition.posterior_second_moment_score: Posterior mean score plus the projected prefix state-displacement covariance
score_definition.weight: Segment length squared divided by segment length squared plus scaled score. Scale selected only to match healthy calibration cost

healthy_calibration_cost: Average conditional nominal true-state MSE across complete frames and calibration paths, measured relative to V0 on those paths

calibration_numeric_conventions.score_scale: first target crossing of log grid 2**j, j=-24..60, from 0; root within bracket

evidence_rule: A directional positive screen requires covariance vs both residual and mean ablation to have lower first-three-tick state MSE, no additional strict first-three pre-alarm events, and matched healthy check costs on both models at a common budget. These archival sizes cannot certify superiority.
